name: @qu/services
description: The Entity API - the layer apps actually call. Hides Qu paths and QuBit envelopes behind plain async methods returning plain values. paths/unwrap/sync-freshness/ListService (docs/v3-technical-concept.md §4.2's derived/curated list primitive), private-storage/StarredService (self-encrypted personal lists), FlagService (the universal Drupal-Flag-style mark/like/bookmark mechanism, private mode over StarredService + public mode over ListService) and its FavoritesService/ContactsService facades.
